ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination with WSN/TN 14-30% and NPN/TN 10-16% over 3 months.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from sheep pasture milk, reduced by pasteurization and no washed rind.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin balanced by 2.1% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue veining in closed pasta-filata paste.

browning.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus lysine drives Maillard when grilled/fried.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate fermentation yields diacetyl ~10 mg/kg and acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis releases butyric 115 mg/kg, caproic 60 mg/kg, total FFA up to ~1600 mg/kg.

creaminess.reason: Fat 26% and FDM ~43-45% lubricates but stretched curd stays firmer than soft cheese.

crumbliness.reason: Aligned stretched paracasein fibers give elastic slice, not short crumbly fracture.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard pasta-filata with ~41.9% moisture and dense cheddared-stretched protein network.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism during ripening.

fruity.reason: Esterase esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol forms ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk C6-C10 acids caproic/caprylic/capric persist after lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker degradation of leucine/isoleucine and early Maillard during hot-water stretching.

melt.reason: Cheddared pH 5.55 demineralized calcium phosphate allows casein flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Minimal 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one with no surface mold and pasteurized milk.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-fat release on heating from 26% fat in coalesced pools in stretched matrix.

smoky.reason: Typical unsmoked make with no wood-smoke phenols like guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Starter lactic acid >1200 mg/100g plus acetic ~77 mg/kg lowers pH to 5.55.

stretch.reason: Pasta-filata hot-water kneading aligns caseins giving long elastic stretch when melted.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Hot-water kneading at 52-70C causes whey denaturation with low H2S/DMS formation.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose ~1% plus proline/glycine and galactose retained.

umami.reason: Rennet plus plasmin proteolysis releases glutamate increasing over 2-6 month aging.
